obfuscation_indicators: believe current cash provides sufficient cash
expect to procure financing upon reasonable terms
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified but presents meaningful financial stress, including a net loss, reduced working capital, reliance on financing, and breaches of debt service coverage covenants. Management emphasizes balance-sheet cleanup and liquidity access, but several projections depend on expected inventory sales, continued credit availability, and favorable financing terms. Complex accounting and bill-and-hold disclosures introduce judgment and execution risks.
